title: The Walled Garden
blurb: Every evening the pests come through the gap in the garden wall and make for the seedbed. By day you plant box hedges to send them the long way round, and along the path whatever answers the night ahead: thrushes for slugs, bats for the moths that fly over it all, ladybirds for greenfly. Then night falls, and you watch.

shots.beat: The Herb Border: hedges send the slugs the long way past a thrush
shots.eval: const moves = [[2,3,3,1],[1,13,2,0],[1,13,3,0],[1,2,4,0],[1,2,3,0],[1,1,2,0],[1,4,6,0]]; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const key = (k) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: String(k) })); const press = (el) => el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); const until = async (sel) => { let el; while (!(el = document.querySelector(sel))) await sleep(50); return el; }; const cell = (x, y) => document.querySelector('.wg-board__cell[aria-label^="' + x + ', ' + y + ':"]'); (async () => { press(await until('[data-testid="enter-herb-border"]')); await until('.wg-board__cell'); for (const [k, x, y] of moves) { key('Escape'); key(k); cell(x, y).click(); } for (const [, x, y, feeds] of moves) for (let i = 0; i < feeds; i++) { key('Escape'); cell(x, y).click(); press(await until('.wg-looked .feed')); await sleep(50); } key('Escape'); })()
